title: Pip Fixes the Gate
note: b416 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new split digraphs e-e, i-e.

pages.brief: A wooden garden gate hanging slightly open and wobbly on its hinge.
Pip the sparrow perched on the fence, studying the wobbly gate.
Pip the sparrow tilting his head, looking thoughtfully at the gate hinge.
Pip the sparrow tapping gently along the loose hinge of the gate with his beak.
Pip the sparrow pulling at the hinge, tightening it against the gate post.
The wooden gate closing firmly and snugly against its post.
Pip the sparrow perched on top of the now-steady gate, looking pleased.
A wide view of the garden gate standing straight and steady.
Pip the sparrow puffed up with pride, sitting on the fixed gate.
Pip the sparrow looking back at the steady gate with a satisfied expression.
